property_summary: For any caller and any nonzero ETH value they send, calling addToBalance succeeds (does not revert) and increases the contract-stored balance for that caller accordingly; the mutant inverts the reentrancy require causing addToBalance to revert for callers when locked_ is false, breaking this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Invert the require so it requires the lock to be true, which will cause calls guarded by the modifier to revert (changing observable behavior).
